#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long comb[777][777];
int R, C;
long long total;
long long best_val = (long long) 1e18, best_z = -1;

void dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
  long long diff = abs(x - y);
  if (best_val <= 1 || diff - comb[v1][R] * comb[v2][R] >= best_val) return;
  if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) {
    long long diff = abs(x - y);
    if (diff < best_val) {
      best_val = diff;
      best_z = x;
    }
    return;
  }
  if (v1 >= R) {
    long long cur1 = comb[v1][R] - comb[v1 - 1][R];
    long long sum2 = comb[v2][R];
    dfs(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
  }
  if (v2 >= R) {
    long long sum1 = comb[v1][R];
    long long cur2 = comb[v2][R] - comb[v2 - 1][R];
    dfs(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
  }
}

char s[12345];
int cntA[12345], cntB[12345];
unordered_map<long long, long long> memo;

long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
  long long state = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
  auto it = memo.find(state);
  if (it != memo.end()) return it->second;
  long long &res = memo[state];
  long long diff = abs(x - y);
  if (diff - comb[v1][R] * comb[v2][R] > best_val) return res = 0;
  if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
    if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
      int sum = v1 + v2;
      v1 -= cntA[sum];
      v2 -= cntB[sum];
      return res = comb[v1 + v2][v1];
    }
    return res = 0;
  }
  res = 0;
  char c = s[v1 + v2 - 1];
  if (c != 'B') {
    long long cur1 = comb[v1][R] - comb[v1 - 1][R];
    long long sum2 = comb[v2][R];
    res += solve(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
  }
  if (c != 'A') {
    long long sum1 = comb[v1][R];
    long long cur2 = comb[v2][R] - comb[v2 - 1][R];
    res += solve(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
  }
  return res;
}

int main() {
  ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
  cin.tie(NULL);
  cin >> R >> C;
  int maxN = 2 * (R + C);
  for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; i++) {
    for (int j = 0; j <= maxN; j++) {
      if (j == 0) comb[i][j] = 1;
      else if (i == 0) comb[i][j] = 0;
      else comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j] + comb[i - 1][j - 1];
    }
  }
  total = comb[R + C][R] * comb[R + C][R];
  {
    long long x = 0, y = 0;
    int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
    while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R) {
      if (x > y) {
        long long cur1 = comb[v1][R] - comb[v1 - 1][R];
        long long sum2 = comb[v2][R];
        y += cur1 * sum2;
        v1--;
      } else {
        long long sum1 = comb[v1][R];
        long long cur2 = comb[v2][R] - comb[v2 - 1][R];
        x += sum1 * cur2;
        v2--;
      }
    }
    best_val = abs(x - y);
  }
  dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
  cin >> s;
  cntA[0] = cntB[0] = 0;
  int len = 2 * (R + C);
  for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (s[i] == 'A');
    cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (s[i] == 'B');
  }
  long long ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
  cout << ans << endl;
  return 0;
}
